confirmedBlockersInOriginalFreeze.cause: run_check constructed firstFailure.exitCode directly from that real command exit (0). The final source failure preserved the existing firstFailure, and run_check returned 0 even though completion.passed was false and no result existed. The workflow could therefore mark its run step successful.
